title: Harnessing the Power of Multi-task Pre-training for Ground-truth-level Natural Language Explanations

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of ground-truth natural language explanations from the e-SNLI-VE dataset validation split to identify gender stereotypes, such as assuming occupational gender roles or making misogynistic assumptions about physical strength.

Qualitative analysis of ground-truth natural language explanations from the e-SNLI-VE dataset validation split to identify racially prejudiced statements and stereotypes, such as asserting that an Asian person cannot have blonde hair.
